assessment: Legacy original review labels for BOTH stages; no legacy-first/detail-final mixing.
first_definition: First captured full render attempt, including failed attempts; not first usable render.
final_definition: Last usable captured full render, not best candidate.
denominator: All planned generation conditions. Technical failures, missing/invalid reviews, partial/fail/uncertain do not count as passes.
main_metric: joint_supported: six necessary checks plus critical_structure and semantic_meaning, and actual generated-asset use/code-controlled data geometry.
reproduction_metric: joint_reproduced additionally requires pixel-identical offline reproduction; separate from image pass.
common_eligible_view: Optional sensitivity view restricted to the same conditions with feasible original reviews at BOTH stages; not the main denominator.
detailed_protocol_limitation: Prior60 first images have no detailed reviews. A fully uniform detailed first-vs-final comparison for all120 references cannot be computed from current evidence.
reference_level_definition: All120 references pooled; a reference passes only if BOTH baseline and conflict pass. Technical failures are not passes.
